gloss: fickle nature; easily bored disposition; someone who gets tired of things quickly

definitions.gloss: fickle nature; easily bored disposition; someone who gets tired of things quickly
definitions.explanation: a personality trait describing someone who loses interest in things quickly and cannot stick with activities or hobbies for long

examples.japanese: ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{飽|あ}き{性|しょう}だ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{続|つづ}かない→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: I'm fickle, so I can't stick with things.

examples.japanese: {飽|あ}き{性|しょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{息子|むすこ}→息子：00799_musuko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦また→また：00969_mata⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{趣味|しゅみ}→趣味：00889_shumi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: My easily-bored son has started yet another new hobby.

examples.japanese: {飽|あ}き{性|しょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{直|なお}したい⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}っている→思う：00492_omou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦なかなか→なかなか：01547_nakanaka⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: I want to fix my fickle nature, but it's quite difficult.

notes:
Functions as both a noun (describing the trait) and a na-adjective modifier. Usually used self-deprecatingly or to describe someone's weakness. Not strongly negative — more like a mild character flaw that people acknowledge openly.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {飽|あ}き{性|しょう}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: a fickle person
- {飽|あ}き{性|しょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{直|なお}す: to fix one's fickle nature
- {飽|あ}き{性|しょう}だ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧: because I get bored easily
- ⟦かなり→かなり：01149_kanari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{飽|あ}き{性|しょう}: quite the fickle type

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{三日坊主|みっかぼうず}→三日坊主：06021_mikkabouzu⟧: someone who gives up after three days — humorous idiom for the same concept
- ⟦{気|き}まぐれ→気まぐれ：07319_kimagure⟧: whimsical, capricious — focuses on unpredictability rather than losing interest
- {移|うつ}り{気|き}: fickleness — literary/formal, often used for romantic fickleness

FORMS:
{飽|あ}き (getting tired of) + ⟦{性|しょう}→〜性：28334_shou⟧ (nature, disposition). The suffix ⟦{性|しょう}→〜性：28334_shou⟧ appears in many personality words: {怒|おこ}り⟦{性|しょう}→〜性：28334_shou⟧ (short-tempered), ⟦{汗|あせ}っかき→汗っかき：19267_asekkaki⟧⟦{性|しょう}→〜性：28334_shou⟧ (sweaty disposition).
